summary: Iteration_27 — Admin Payments: cashbox_id / bank_account_id are now optional with confirmation UX. Backend pytest 6/6 PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_payments_optional_fields.py): income bank-only (empty cashbox_id), expense cashbox-only (empty bank_account_id), expense bank-only (empty cashbox_id — previously 400), PUT /payments/{id} with empty bank_account_id all return 200; no 'zorunludur' error anywhere. Frontend Playwright E2E PASS: (1) income with empty bank → AlertDialog shows empty-field-confirm-text 'Banka hesabı alanı boş. Böyle kaydetmek istediğinize emin misiniz?' + hint 'yalnızca branş/kasa bakiyesine yansıyacak'; Vazgeç cancels; Evet, kaydet triggers POST /api/payments 200 with bank_account_id='' and populated cashbox_id (auto-resolved from branch), toast 'Ödeme eklendi'. (2) expense Ofis cashbox-empty + bank picked → confirm names 'Branş / Kasa' with hint 'yalnızca banka hesabına yansıyacak'; Evet saves cashbox_id='' bank_account_id set, 200. (3) Regression: all-fields-filled income saves WITHOUT showing the confirm dialog (POST 200 directly). All created payments were cleaned up via DELETE /api/payments/{id}.

issues: Dialog label still shows 'Banka Hesabı *' and 'Kasa *' with asterisk even though fields are now optional (soft-required with confirmation). Consider removing the asterisk or changing placeholder to indicate opsiyonel.
Radix DialogContent a11y console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' — pre-existing, non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Drop the '*' marker on 'Kasa' and 'Banka Hesabı' labels in AdminPayments.jsx form (lines 808, 911) so UI matches new optional semantics.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription to the add/edit payment Dialog to remove the a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: handleSubmitPayment mutates newPayment.cashbox_id directly (line 250) instead of using setNewPayment — works because doSavePayment is called synchronously after, but violates React immutability; could cause subtle bugs if React batches a re-render in between.

doSavePayment closes emptyFieldConfirm and dialog on error path only partially — on failure the main Dialog remains open (good) but emptyFieldConfirm also stays closed because the handler returned via toast.error; verify: currently setEmptyFieldConfirm({open:false}) only runs on success path. In practice the confirm dialog is auto-closed by AlertDialogAction click so this is OK, but worth a comment.

Backend Payment / PaymentCreate models already have Optional[str] = None for both ids (lines 369-370, 386-387). Empty string '' is accepted and stored as-is; balance aggregation queries filter by exact match, so '' doesn't collide with real ids. Good.
No normalization: cashbox_id/bank_account_id can be stored as '' or None depending on client. Consider normalizing to None in create_payment/update_payment for cleaner data.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. 3 test payments created during the run were all deleted via DELETE /api/payments/{id}.
